profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Passionate about the user experience and stakeholder's input when developing and upgrading web based business applications.

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
positions.description: Managed team of four engineers building and maintaining historical, academic, research-quality stock market databases. Guided the team through research, analysis and definition of tasks to achieve business goals, maintenance to stay in support windows, internal process documentation, cross training and education.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps · Apache Spark · Scrum · Azure Databricks · Jira · docker

company.name: Center for Research in Security Prices, LLC (CRSP)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Engineer for a product which aggregates data mining and user data for school supply lists, manages retailer affiliate account linking, and runs on reliable/scalable infrastructure to support retail websites with very high volume traffic. Deploying infrastructure as code to AWS with Pulumi, migrating legacy application to NodeJS/NextJS/React stack. Onboarding and mentoring for new developers.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · React.js · MySQL · Node.js · docker · Sequelize.js · Next.js

company.name: School Family Media® | TeacherLists™ | College Checklists™ | PTO Today®

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full Stack, Data Engineering pipelines, analysis and design, lead teams of performance, data, and application engineers implementing data-pipeline enhancements, performance and stress testing and integrating a pub/sub notification service to an existing platform to give individual micro-services and users more control and a more unified experience. Helped with project management, analysis, QA and on-field support.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeORM · PostgreSQL · RabbitMQ · Node.js · docker · NestJS

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Maintaining and building applications to support the dean’s office as well as faculty and staff needs within the Weinberg College and University. Utilizing serverless architecture to load data from university web services into external software.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · JavaScript · Amazon SQS · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: User Interface Developer
positions.description: Upgraded core business components of an existing Sencha ExtJS application to Ext6 with Sencha Cmd. Through the process built and maintained a documented (JSDuck, YUIDocs) library of reusable components and common packages for use in development of applications. Lead developer of the current PACE UI portal and business components for internal and external applications of Ice Clear Credit. Charting with HighCharts and HighStock, GIT and Perforce for source control, Jenkins for CI and deployments, JIRA for project management.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Maintaining, upgrading and creating new applications with the javascript framework Sencha ExtJS. Server side code to support RESTful APIs and convert from legacy programs. Requirement gathering, rapid development and customer collaboration to facilitate agile development.

positions.title: Valence Developer (ExtJS & Sencha)
positions.description: Developing web apps for businesses using the Valence Framework. Development in RPGIV, SQL, node.js and Ext JS 3 and 4.

positions.title: Report Writer/Programmer
positions.description: Report writing and application development for Case Management and Credentialing software for hospitals and medical offices using Crystal Reports, Business Objects Enterprise, VB/.Net and SQL Server

positions.title: Report Writer
positions.description: Administration of a Business Objects Enterprise XI server. Created universes to provide back end support for Web Intelligence and Dashboards. Developed in Crystal Reports and SQL Server T-SQL to create and modify business intelligence reports.
